registered: 2026-10-14, before any stage-E code was written or run
purpose: quantify possible drift of eps = Q_CK - Q_fc from cell-to-cell differences; not scored on proxies

scenarios.S0_cancellation: checkup discharge ends at the 5.1 A pack 11.2 V root and the anchor charge starts from that state; start state cancels; pack-CV tops in both -> drift 0 by construction (reported as the reference case)
scenarios.S1_no_cancellation: eps_k = x*_k + const, x*_k = Ah still dischargeable at 5.1 A from the anchor start state to the pack 11.2 V root: per cell, start rest voltage minus dV (dV in {0, 0.05, 0.10} V) -> remaining Ah r_i on the CK0 loaded tail; pack root: smallest x>=0 with sum_i V_i^CK0(Q0_i - r_i + x) <= 11.2 (Q0_i = end of the CK0 curve). Drift reported relative to anchor 1 (all 25 C), k = 2..7; anchor 0 (45 C) reported separately as a sanity check against eps0 = 0.288
scenarios.S2_cell_limited_top: checkup full charge terminated by the first cell reaching its limit instead of pack CV: drift_k = -(max_i rel_i(k) - max_i rel_i(1)), rel_i = per-cell discharge step depth minus four-cell mean, averaged over the 45 C steps of month k-1 (month-end state)

decision: if max |drift| < 0.10 pp in every scenario considered plausible -> negligible; otherwise register an eps-drift-corrected V2 variant as leaderboard-only (never claimed as a proxy improvement)
plausibility_evidence: stage A exploratory: Q_fc residuals are uncorrelated with start-state tail Ah (r = 0.04), which argues against S1 being large
